fields.division: In cooperation with the State Animal Health Office and county extension
fields.headline: Swine and poultry shows cancelled at the Tamarack County Fair
fields.summary: A disease investigation is under way in the county. To protect animals, the swine and poultry shows are cancelled. Other fair events, including the dairy and beef shows and the midway, continue.
exhibitors: Keep animals at home and do not bring them to the fairgrounds.
Watch animals for illness and call your veterinarian.
fields.refunds: Entry fees are refunded by mail within 30 days.
